_comment: Field battles: an army holding a hex fights any horde whose route crosses it. Ambush: on `ambush.terrain`, with the army in place `ambush.prepMinutes` game minutes before the horde arrives, the defenders' first round hits `ambush.bonus` harder and the horde fights it without its stance. Choke point: a passable hex with at least `choke.minBlockedNeighbors` impassable neighbours; attackers hit `choke.attackerFactor` as hard there, and Hold the Line gains `choke.holdTheLineDefense` defense. Forts are built within `fort.range` hexes of a village and give armies holding them `fort.defenseBonus` defense. Bridges are built over a river edge within `bridge.range` hexes of a village (game seconds, divided by world speed); until one stands nothing crosses there, hordes included. Roads are built between two neighbouring hexes within `road.range` of a village; moving along one costs `road.factor` of the terrain, for players and the human hordes alike, but the Monsters of the North keep off them.
